### SmartHelio® Live Webinar


# Solar AI Agents: Buzzword or Breakthrough?


AI agents are transforming energy operations, but when real assets and financial risk are involved, accuracy is non-negotiable. Watch the replay to discover what separates trustworthy AI from the hype.


[Access your Replay](https://share-eu1.hsforms.com/1CJk3Dk9WQjyqprIbUzD4TAewpai)

# Why attend?


- What AI tools


like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Copilot can actually do in real solar & storage operations today
- Where AI helps operators make faster, smarter decisions and where human validation still matters
- The practical risks, limitations, and future of AI in energy operations beyond the marketing hype


**AI agents** are entering every part of the energy industry. From performance optimization and market insights to fault analysis and operational decision-making, the promises are huge. But when real assets, real money, and real operational risks are involved, **how far can AI actually be trusted?**


**** Join SmartHelio, industry experts, and solar operators for a practical discussion on what is really happening today with AI in solar & storage operations **beyond the marketing noise** .
